title.value: Prospective evaluation of bleeding risk among thrombocytopenic patients admitted in intensive care unit
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper.
title.quote: Prospective evaluation of bleeding risk among thrombocytopenic patients admitted in intensive care unit

analysis.description: This paper presents a prospective observational study conducted in an 18-bed medical ICU aimed at evaluating the bleeding risk among thrombocytopenic patients. The study focuses on identifying predictive factors for bleeding and characterizing hemorrhagic events during ICU stays.

type.justification: The study involves the collection and analysis of observational data from a real-world clinical setting, thus making it empirical.
type.quote: A prospective observational study conducted in an 18-bed medical ICU.

name.justification: The study is conducted in an ICU setting focusing on patients and medical conditions, which falls under the healthcare domain.
name.quote: Purpose: Bleeding risk evaluation of thrombocytopenic patients admitted in ICU has been poorly investigated.

name.justification: The study focuses on evaluating clinical outcomes and bleeding risks in ICU patients, aligning it with clinical research.
name.quote: This is a single-center prospective study conducted in an 18-bed medical intensive care unit at a tertiary teaching hospital.
